# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 108 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 108

Jesus said: "Anyone who drinks from my mouth will become like me — I will become that person myself — and what has been hidden will be revealed to them."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Drinks from my mouth" — the oral transmission of living teaching
- "I will become that person myself" — the reciprocal union emphasized
- "What has been hidden" — the hidden things as past-hidden, now ready for revelation
